disposition.reason: Neighbors appealed the Bristol ZBA's July 6, 2004 conditional use approval, a municipal land-use decision, but the proposal is a gravel extraction project on a 65-acre tract, a nonresidential extraction use, not new housing.

evidence.quote: Applicant has proposed the development of a gravel extraction project on an approximately 65-acre tract of land that abuts South Street and Rounds Road
the ZBA issued approval on July 6, 2004. A number of individuals, including some of the Movants here, appealed that decision; their appeal was assigned Docket No. 122-7-04 Vtec.
remanded to the Bristol Zoning Board of Adjustment (ZBA) for consideration on the merits of the conditional use application

judgments.note: Docket 122-7-04 is the neighbors' appeal of the ZBA's conditional use approval (municipal appeal = yes); every version of the project is gravel extraction, a nonresidential use (housing = no). Shared decisions also decide 210-9-08 Vtec (second conditional use denial) and 136-8-10 Vtec (Act 250); only their statements about 122-7-04 were used. Scope established from docs 1-2; remaining text not needed for an excluded case.

history.note: Excluded: appeal of Bristol ZBA conditional use approval for a gravel extraction project, not housing.
